question: If 20% of 10% of 2/3 of a number is 697. Find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all percentages into fractions and equate directly to the given value:

⇒ 20% = 1/5 and 10% = 1/10

⇒ (1/5) × (1/10) × (2/3) × Number = 697

⇒ (2/150) × Number = 697 ⇒ (1/75) × Number = 697

⇒ Number = 697 × 75 = 52275

**∴ The correct answer is 52275.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of 10% of 2/3 of a number is 697.

 N

 × 20% N/75 = 697 Equivalent Operation: N × (2/3) × (1/10) × (1/5) = N / 75 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the required number be N.

⇒ 20% of 10% of (2/3) of N = 697

⇒ (20/100) × (10/100) × (2/3) × N = 697

⇒ (1/5) × (1/10) × (2/3) × N = 697

⇒ 2 / (5 × 10 × 3) × N = 697

⇒ (2 / 150) × N = 697

⇒ (1 / 75) × N = 697

⇒ N = 697 × 75

⇒ N = 52275

**∴ The correct answer is 52275.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Equivalents of Percentages

Converting percentages directly to fractions dramatically speeds up calculations. For example, 20% = 1/5, 10% = 1/10, 25% = 1/4, and 50% = 1/2.

BODMAS Rule in Simplification

The term "of" indicates multiplication but holds a higher precedence than standard division and multiplication as per the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction).

Successive Percentage Chaining

When finding sequential fractions or percentages (e.g., a% of b% of c), the values are simply multiplied in a chain. The operation is commutative, meaning changing the order of calculation does not change the result.
